sampling: one independently hashed position per game, mover Elo at least 2200, moves 9–40; cycle year, Elo band, moves 9–20/21–40 and below-20/at-least-20-piece strata until 500 positions
eligibility: verified classical event pool; exact independent score/result and compatible participant names required; no Pan-Pacific records without an independent score
judge_search: one shared-root MultiPV search over distinct release recommendations; common completed depth; native mover WDL
rationale: The 25k learning pilot changed 44/229 recommendations at 100k, with 33/229 expected-loss changes above 0.02. Use 100k with a presampled 400k check for this finite descriptive advice comparison; this does not establish adequate main learning budgets.
limits: The finite source pool is dominated by the 2024 Olympiad and cannot support historical human learning or skill trends.
Preference agreement is distinct from modern-judge quality; no engine release is ground truth.
This run covers four Stockfish releases only; it does not estimate preference changes from Fruit 2.1 or untested releases.
Confidence intervals resample sampled games/positions and omit corpus-selection and judge uncertainty.
Opening turnover and Maia mapping are outside this analysis.

amendment.reason: correction of a methodological claim after the run; sampling and search parameters unchanged
amendment.correction: The original reason given for excluding Fruit was wrong: ignored root restriction does not prevent judging its unrestricted recommendation with a modern engine. Fruit was not run in this sample; the result remains limited to the four named Stockfish releases.
